launcher.notes: KINETRIX LAUNCHER 3.0.0 - ALL VERSIONS. The launcher now plays every Minecraft version with Forge or Fabric, installs mods from Modrinth and CurseForge, and imports Modrinth profiles - while the Kinetrix 1.8.9 flagship stays untouched as the home-screen LAUNCH 1.8.9 button. VERSIONS: a new Versions page lists every Mojang version (releases, snapshots, old beta/alpha); pick a version + loader (Vanilla/Forge/Fabric) and it installs into its own folder with its own saves, mods and configs, so nothing collides. Modern Forge installs through the OFFICIAL Forge installer run headless and Java 17/21 runtimes are detected or downloaded automatically. The home LAUNCH button follows the selected version and the arrow next to it is the quick version switcher. MODS: a new Mods page searches Modrinth and CurseForge for the exact version + loader you picked, installs with one click (sha1-verified) and manages installed mods (enable/disable/delete). CurseForge works out of the box via a public community mirror; your own free API key (console.curseforge.com) can be pasted in Settings for the official API. MODRINTH PROFILES: import a whole modpack by picking its .mrpack file or pasting a modrinth.com/modpack link - version, loader, configs and every mod are set up automatically. Everything else is unchanged: Microsoft sign-in, accounts, Quick Play, cosmetics locker with the 3D preview, crash doctor, auto-update.

notes: Kinetrix Client 3.12.0 - HiDPI CLARITY OVERHAUL. If you play on a 2K/4K monitor and the home screen, menus or HUD looked blurry, that's fixed: every custom font was baked at a fixed 2x density and stretched up to 4.5x on screen; now fonts bake at your framebuffer's real density (pixel-exact at 1080p/1440p, up to 3x sharper on 4K). The home-screen hero text bakes at full density instead of being matrix-stretched, HUD text re-bakes on resolution/GUI-scale change, the home-screen backdrop ships at 2048x1024 with a 1024px logo, and menu blur composites at a higher resolution. Bonus fix: switching resolutions used to leak every font atlas's VRAM. Layout and gameplay are unchanged - same UI, just crisp.
